notes: Processed all 20 Penn Clubs entries and fetched 14 club websites (34 fetches, 0 WebSearch calls). Verdicts: 20 publish, 0 hide, 0 not_a_group, 0 duplicate, 0 out_of_area. Three records are held back as status unknown, with summary, categories and interests left out: The Italian Club at Penn, The Undergraduate Law Journal at Penn, and The Petey Greene Program at Penn. In each, the directory's status field reads INACTIVE and no dated evidence on the group's own pages settles it. Status otherwise follows the newest dated item found on the club's own site or the directory; season-only or year-only notices are noted per record. For many clubs the directory's application field is an unlabeled number, so newcomer ratings rely on the descriptions. Christian groups have faith left empty because the vocabulary has no general Christian id. One directory weekday (Sunday, September 7, 2026) is wrong, so weekdays were left out. No personal names, phone numbers or personal emails were recorded. Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, GroupMe and Linktree pages were not read (leads only). No rate limiting was seen. The two HTTP 403 sites were not retried.
